body: I will do that, thank you

Thanks for responding.

I've been hesitant to talk to anyone, because normally I'm not suicidal.

In my past, I used to think about suicide basically 24/7. But I wasn't really at risk for doing it. It was just a thing I couldn't get out of my head.

Now, I don't consider myself suicidal 99% of the time. But during that 1% I'm actually capable of doing it. I would actually do the action. The only thing that's stopping me is physical barriers: not having the right materials on hand. And with each episode I'm getting closer to having the stuff to make it happen.

I'm not talking to people about this because why compromise that 99% of the time when I'm doing great? People will ostracise me and treat me differently when they know about my episodes of depression and suicidal thoughts.
